name: mood_tracker
title: mood_tracker
description: Create a FastAPI app called Daily Mood Tracker with routes /, /log, /history, /summary. It should store id, date (unique), mood (1-5), note in SQLite, have a minimal Jinja2 UI, and compute a 7-day average with an emoji.
